# λWAVES conductor targets (GENERATED — do not edit)

Generated by `tools/conduct-targets.mjs` from the live registry on 2026-10-29: 389 targets and 73 NODES knobs. Run it again after a target changes; never hand-edit this file.
A lane point's value is in the target's own unit (the registry's `toNorm` makes it the curve's 0…1); `wrap` targets turn freely (a lane may run past max: it is split at the seam); `integer` targets step; `trigger` / `toggle` (the `action.*` acts) fire on an edge through 0.5 — use `triggers` for them. `chem.orbital`'s range is the landed molecule's (1…its orbital count); the row shows the boot ceiling.
A NODES knob is named by the node's TYPE in a score (`nodes.decohere.amount`, or `nodes.grain#2.amount` for the second FILM GRAIN); the conductor resolves it to the placed node's id.
